mentions.name: Skill-Provenance
mentions.description: Version tracking system for AI agent skills that embeds version headers, a changelog, and a manifest inside each skill bundle, so any session can verify which version it received when skill files move between Claude, Codex, Copilot, and local storage.
mentions.problem: When skill files move between Claude, Codex, Copilot, and local storage, they lose their version identity; the author kept losing track of which version of which skill was running where.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on version tracking for AI agent skills. When skill files move between Claude, Codex, Copilot, and local storage, they lose their version identity. Skill-Provenance embeds version headers, a changelog, and a manifest inside the skill bundle so any session can verify what it received.
